# All Cryptids in Fallout 76

![All Cryptids in Fallout 76](/uploads/273_blog-teaser-template.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

Cryptids (originating from Greek κρύπτω / krypto and meaning "to hide" / "to hide") are mystical types of animals and creatures that appear in local folklore and other contexts, but whose actual existence is questionable.

There are a number of cryptids in Fallout 76. We have put together a list of all cryptids for you. This list is occasionally interesting, for example for challenges.

![Cryptids List Fallout 76](/uploads/nukaknights-all-cryptids-list.png)

## Mothman / Mothman

The Mothman is a type of mutant creature from Appalachia named after a 20th century folklore figure. The Mothman is a giant insect worshiped by the Mothman cultists. There is still a prewar Mothman Museum in Point Pleasant.

You can find the Mothman either at the random encounter points (see map below), at the events "**Path to Enlightenment**" / seasonal "**Mothman Equinox**", as well as in the Enclave Research Facility (Transmission Station 1AT-U03) and also in the daily quest "**Queen of the Hunt**". Mothman hatchlings also spawn with cultists in daily operations.

![Mothman](/uploads/nukaknights-mothman-skywalka55-fallout76-20200404-21-40-08.jpg) 

## Grafton Monsters

The Grafton Monster, a cryptid associated with West Appalachia, is one of the incarnated West Tek experiments from the Huntersville facility. Based on the FEVS-006458 strain, researchers created a stable terrible mutation on October 23, 2077. The genome based on the Snallygaster strain was altered, creating a giant that destroyed the containment unit but remained otherwise stable (aside from the missing head).

The Grafton Monster spawns at the Charleston Trainyard, at the Charleston Capitol Building, south of Hemlock Holes, occasionally in Whitespring and the dry lake in Toxic Valley, as well as in the events "**Grafton Tag**", "**Project Paradise**", "**Heart of the Swamp**" (with 90% damage reduction), "**The Wheel**" and also in "**Queen of the Hunt**". You can find it at some “one-a-bite” events during the seasonal meat week event.

![Grafton Monster](/uploads/nukaknights-grafton-monster-2023-04-13-170220.jpg) 

## Flatwood's Monster

The Flatwoods Monster is a floating creature with glowing purple eyes and the ability to kidnap Wastelanders. The wandering storyteller shares details about the creature and warns that "its mere presence can distort the minds of all but the most iron-hearted."

In the game, this ability is occasionally shown by the fact that other enemies in the game are covered with a purple glow and are controlled by the Flatwoods Monster, making them stronger. In this case you should always find the Flatwoods monster before dealing with the "controlled" opponents.

During combat, the Flatwoods Monster also teleports to different places and also regenerates health.

The Flatwoods Monster spawns (at night only) at **Random Encounter** points with a 2.5% chance (see map). *Tip:* *It spawns relatively often on the rock at Site Alpha's lake. If you specifically look for it, you can do server hopping in this location.*

Additional spawns include the events "**Attackers from Space**" (seasonal), "**Tales around the Campfire**", **Daily Operations** (boss), as well as the **Dailies** "Queen of the Hunt" and "Making Sacrifice".

The Flatwoods Monster is also an **Alien** and also counts for the challenges.

![Flatwoods Monster](/uploads/nukaknights-flatwoods-monster-skywalka55-fallout76-20200406-02-29-28.jpg)
